library_bugs.fix_direction: Parser should drop elements that have no recognized keys (for/by/host/proto) per RFC 7239 §4's extension-rule principle (downstream consumers MUST NOT reject on unknown names; symmetrically, downstream consumers see only known keys).
library_bugs.root_cause: parse(s) returns an element with for_=[] and by/host/proto=None for inputs that contain only unknown forward-pair names (e.g. 'foo=bar'). format() emits '' for such an element (no parts to join). Re-parsing '' produces Forwarded(elements=()) — an empty list — breaking AC7's round-trip idempotence property.
library_bugs.title: Idempotence violation: element with no recognized keys drops on round-trip

oracle_harness_bugs.fix_direction: Either (a) implement full escape resolution in the oracle, or (b) loosen the harness assertion to only compare on UNQUOTED inputs (treating the oracle as a sanity check, not strict).
oracle_harness_bugs.root_cause: _oracle_extract_for_values strips surrounding quotes but does NOT resolve RFC 7230 §3.2.6 escape pairs (\\" → ", \\\\ → \). This causes disagreement with the real parser on quoted values containing backslashes/quotes. Per harness docstring, the oracle is 'intentionally naive' for sanity, but at corpus scale it surfaces as a real 'mismatch' noise floor that masks real differences.
oracle_harness_bugs.title: Cross-cycle regex oracle doesn't resolve quoted-string backslash escapes

random_generator_harness_bugs.fix_direction: Either reject bare_backslash as the last character, or append one more 'safe' character at the end. The bug is in the harness, not the library — the parser is correctly rejecting malformed input.
random_generator_harness_bugs.root_cause: _harness_common.random_quoted_value allows emitting a 'bare_backslash' (\) as the LAST character of a generated body. When wrapped in '"..."', the closing quote is preceded by an unpaired \, which the parser correctly flags as 'unterminated quoted-string' per RFC 7230 §3.2.6. The harness docstring claims the body is 'always well-formed' but that invariant is not enforced for the trailing character.
random_generator_harness_bugs.title: random_quoted_value() may emit bodies ending in bare backslash

random_generator_harness_bugs.root_cause: CLI's contract is: exit 0 with non-empty input must produce non-empty stdout. For 'foo=bar' (unknown-key element), parse() returns a Forwarded with an element whose serialized form is '' (after format()). The CLI then writes nothing (line 84: if out: writes), producing empty stdout. The harness asserts 'non-empty stdout on exit 0' which fails. Root cause is the same library bug as F-001 — once the parser drops elements with no recognized keys, format/CLI behavior is consistent.
random_generator_harness_bugs.title: CLI emits empty stdout for inputs that produce empty formatted output
